items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Sidney Desvinge's big band... [INTERVIEWEE] He played all that. Oh, yes.

ctx.x: What's he called that? I don't know. What's he called that?
Sidney Desvinge's big band. Yeah, there it is. Yeah. Sidney Desvinge's big band. And Shuffle Rhythm, After Hours, Back Beat Boogie, C.C. Rider. !
He played all that. Oh, yes.
